name: University of Sydney Interest-Free Student Loan
summary: Interest-free loan for University of Sydney students needing help with essential living and study expenses.
key: Student loans of up to $2000 are available throughout the year.
who: Enrolled University of Sydney student in need of assistance with essential living and study expenses
how: Complete the online application and upload supporting documents in Sydney Student (My finance > Apply for financial support)
catches: Must be repaid; repayment terms are agreed when the loan is approved
You will not be able to graduate until your loan is repaid

evidence.quote: Student loans of up to $2000 are available throughout the year.
